raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Part 05 of 21 of the LoRA runtime stack (branch `lora-stack-04-dense-tables`, base `lora-stack-03-dense-plans`). The stack is cut from the development branch of #42284.

## What this part adds

Add the tuned sm90 and sm100 dense plan tables. A device without a table keeps
the in-code defaults.

Tests: the shipped vocab plans keep the supported execution contract, the
Blackwell routed rows, and the H200 serial in_proj exceptions.

## Verification

- GB300 run r45: the tree of upstream main `c1c287a429` plus parts 01–05 imports every module this part changes and passes this part's tests together with every earlier part's unit tests: **7 passed, 20 warnings in 20.04s**.
- `pre-commit` passed on the changed files of every part; `pre-commit run --all-files` passed on the complete stack tree.

The complete 21-part tree equals the development branch of #42284 at `e7b7179a86` (the `6588053ef2` tree with four test-only follow-ups squashed into its dense commit: the admission/snapshot trim, the restored FP8 block-shape admission pin, a second trim that keeps only the tests guarding silent failures and adds pins for four coverage gaps, and restored numerical and packing coverage; production code is unchanged) minus the benchmark tools and the Triton MoE tuning tables, which follow in separate PRs.

Previous: #42871 · Next: #42873
